title: Steward concept card
description: What the player's prompt means, split into orthogonal fields. Claude fills it from free text (a structured job); the player edits and approves it before anything is generated.

name.description: Short display name for the settlement.

site.description: Shape and place: how the settlement sits on or in the land.

template.description: A known site template id (see prompts/concept-card.md) or null for a custom form.

terrain.description: find = use existing terrain that fits; sculpt = reshape terrain (shown with a block count, undoable); flat = build on level ground.

style.description: Look and mood: palette, motifs, materials, lighting.

purpose.description: What the settlement is for: drives the mix of lots and, later, functional modules.

story.description: Optional backstory used for details, signs and books.

avoid.description: Things the player does not want, taken from the prompt.

interpretation.description: One short paragraph: what Claude took each field to mean, in plain words for the player.

contradictions.description: Tensions between fields and how the card resolved them; empty when none.

assumptions.description: Fields the prompt did not specify and Claude filled in; each is editable by the player.
